metrics.name: clarity
metrics.description: How clear and understandable is the summary?

params.prompt: Rate the clarity of the following summary on a scale from 1 (unclear) to 5 (very clear). Provide a short rationale.

metrics.name: coherence
metrics.description: Does the summary flow logically and maintain coherence?

params.prompt: Rate the coherence of the following summary on a scale from 1 (incoherent) to 5 (very coherent). Provide a short rationale.

metrics.name: engagement
metrics.description: How engaging or interesting is the summary?

params.prompt: Rate the engagement of the following summary on a scale from 1 (boring) to 5 (very engaging). Provide a short rationale.
